GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Barbara Joseph, Paul & Matt Jones) Jumped Well Settled Down 1.5l rail home turn 2.5l followed ldr/winner run ended 75m 1st up # peaked late/fitter
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 3 Wide 6 lengths. very Wide turn 6 lengths. battled away # Wide trip

Ride query fast tempo early & middle stages. R-instr to lead. Speed Set  had been too fast and should have taken action sooner to restain mount Tr-mare had gone too quick, compromised ability to finish off its race, expressed disappointment with ride,Vet- lame off foreleg. # lame/went2fast
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qst re fast tempo, rdr reported her instructions were to lead, however in retrospect the speed set had been too fast and she should have taken action sooner to restrain her mnt. Tnr confirmed the intructions but said the mare had gone too quickly which had compromised its ability to finish off its race. Rdr was told that in similar circumstances she must show greater judgement to ease the tempo. A post-race vet exam revealed mare to be lame (1/5) off foreleg. Tnr was told a vet clearance is required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.
